item.title: Drag queen Trixie Mattel has a new holiday album — but think Halloween, not Christmas
item.description: On Wild Card, well-known guests answer questions about topics we don't always talk about. Drag queen Trixie Mattel reflects on whether competition has been a positive or negative force in her life.

item.title: Following far-right and far-left gains, Germany's center struggles for relevance
item.description: After gains for the far-right and far-left, Germany's centrist politicians are soul-searching among echoes of a past that led to the collapse of the Weimar Republic and rise of fascism decades ago.

item.title: The G7 will release 100 million reserve barrels of diesel fuel over the next 4 months
item.description: After increased pressure from Washington, the G7 held an emergency meeting on energy. The world's wealthiest nations say they will release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel fuel in their reserves.
item.content:encoded: After increased pressure from Washington, the G7 held an emergency meeting on energy. The world's wealthiest nations say they will release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel fuel in their reserves.

item.title: Remembering Brooke Eby, the TikTok star who documented her ALS journey
item.description: After Brooke Eby was diagnosed with ALS, she started to document her experience. The influencer was perhaps best known for her humor. Now, four years after her official diagnosis, Eby has died.

item.title: 'Disturbed' by Cornell rape investigation, NY governor puts state AG in charge
item.description: The Cornell University Police Department is leading the investigation into an alleged gang rape two years ago. How effective is that approach, and is the campus police accountable to the public?

item.title: Talk of drones and a burning flame on Trump's D.C. arch worries aviation experts
item.description: Aviation safety experts were wary of Trump's proposed arch near D.C.'s airport. Then came the FAA's unusual lighting recommendations — including an eternal flame on top — and Trump's talk of drones.

item.description: Tom Cruise plays an oil tycoon who causes, and must then fix, an ecological disaster in Alejandro González Iñárritu's wild — and wildly divisive — satirical comedy.

item.title: As fertilizer prices rise, Zambian farmers turn to bokashi compost
item.description: The price of fertilizer rose dramatically in Zambia thanks to global conflicts. This sent some farmers searching for alternatives, including a home-made compost popularized in Asia.

item.title: With a voice as vast as the ocean, Beth Taylor has arrived
item.description: The deep-voiced Scottish mezzo-soprano just made her Royal Opera House debut. Now, with her debut solo album, The Deeps Have Music, she is on the doorstep of stardom.
